items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Well, in that band was Joe Robichaud on piano, Thero Poitain on alto, and Albert Martin, we call them Fats on drums.

ctx.x: Budweiser? Was it near the Budweiser?

Well, maybe this was the fern, it was the Budweiser and the fern, they were right next to each other. The Vila was the La Vila? La Vila, that's it, that's it. Yeah. John Maria had charge of that job, and he had... It was his job, John Maria to banjo. Well, like I said, I used to always go around, you see. In fact, I can tell you, there's a different place, they had a different place on St. Charles and Cronolette. They had one on Burgundy and Canal.
